title: Build, maintain and cold-reuse a real CLI verifier

origin.reference: Pstack adaptation comparison; executable fixture evals/fixtures/verify-loop

task.prompt: Build the reusable task-completion verification capability required by README.md and make it discoverable from the repository. Execute and validate it; keep product behavior unchanged.

user_script.after: builder finishes; the fixture owner renames the public complete command to finish
user_script.content: The application has been upgraded. Maintain the repository verification capability, preserve its business expectations, and execute the affected paths. Do not edit product code.

user_script.after: maintainer finishes; start a fresh executor with only repository files
user_script.content: Use this repository's instructions to verify the task-completion workflow and report evidence. Do not edit product code or verification tools.

requirements.criterion: The generated verifier drives public CLI operations, detects a false business result, cleans owned state and retains evidence.
After the public completion command changes, a cold maintainer repairs tools and instructions without changing the requirement or product.
A fresh executor discovers and runs the maintained verifier from project instructions without conversation history.

graders.procedure: Run evals/experiments/verify_loop.py outside the executor. Replay generated commands in isolated copies; inject a completion mutation; inspect public CLI audit, state cleanup, retained evidence, product hashes and cold-executor trace. For the light case use private boundary tests and trace/file checks. Retain per-stage gate.json.
